content:
A refund reduces the quota generated by its original order even if part of that quota was consumed. The quota may become negative, representing a debt of justified capacity.

A system-permitted early conversion can leave that debt after a later refund. Other current eligible order records may generate separate positive quotas, but they do not erase the history of using a refunded order.

Sources and consumed allocations remain in conversion receipts.
